task: Welcome to another exciting game of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First stop, try to venture west. After that, go to the south. If you can succeed at that, make an effort to take a trip west. With that done, make an attempt to move north. And then, make an attempt to go north. Once you get around to doing that, head north. Following that, attempt to go to the east. And then, retrieve the cashew from the bureau. And if you do that, you're the winner!
